violation_type.title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §747.2807(a))
violation_type.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a child in care was not able to nap and an alternate activity was not provided.

finding_variants.text: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a child in care was not able to nap and an alternate activity was not provided.
